name: Warpstriker cuts spell costs by 5% and adds 15% dispel resistance (#570)
contract: Warpstriker 707556 is a passive with two effects. Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DISPEL_RESIST (235) with EffectBasePoints 14, resolving to 15 with DieSides 1: the tooltip's $s1. Aura::CalcDispelChance (SpellAuras.cpp) consumes it as auraTarget->GetTotalAuraModifier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_DISPEL_RESIST), under 'if (offensive && auraTarget)'. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_POWER_COST_SCHOOL_PCT (72) with EffectMiscValue 127 (all schools) and EffectBasePoints -6, resolving to -5: the tooltip's $s2. AuraEffect::HandleModPowerCostPCT writes UNIT_FIELD_POWER_COST_MULTIPLIER per school and SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost multiplies the cost by (1 + multiplier). Epoch 501779 is the priced spell: PowerType 0, ManaCostPercentage 18, SchoolMask 80 whose first school is 4. SCOPE OF THE DISPEL HALF, asserted only as the applied amount: the native modifier is read off the unit carrying the aura being dispelled and only when the dispel is offensive, so Warpstriker protects auras on the Chronomancer from enemy purges; it does not protect auras the Chronomancer placed on other units, because a friendly dispel is not offensive and the caster-side lever for that is SPELLMOD_RESIST_DISPEL_CHANCE (op 28), which 707556 does not carry. The harness cannot stage an enemy purge (no player-versus-player dispel), so the resistance roll itself is left to code trace; a Ghost e2e test with two hostile characters would be needed to observe it. Native handlers only. Regression scenario for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Warpstriker is not applied without learning it
Warpstriker self-applies its passive aura once learned
The dispel resistance effect resolves to 15
The power cost effect resolves to -5
